title: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login
impact: Logs in as administrator with no valid password, exposing full admin functionality.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never concatenate user input into SQL; enforce server-side auth checks.

title: UNION-based SQL injection in product search leaks user credentials
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM Users--
impact: Dumps every user's email and password hash, enabling offline cracking and account takeover.
remediation: Use parameterized queries; least-privilege DB account; validate input; never build SQL by string concatenation.

title: Reflected/DOM XSS in product search field
impact: Attacker JavaScript runs in the victim's browser under the app origin, enabling phishing and session theft.
remediation: Contextually encode output; avoid bypassSecurityTrustHtml; use Angular's built-in escaping; enforce a strict CSP.

title: DOM XSS in search escalated to session-token theft
impact: Executes arbitrary JS in the victim's session and exfiltrates the JWT from localStorage, enabling full account takeover.
remediation: Encode/escape output; store session tokens in httpOnly cookies, not localStorage; enforce a strict CSP.
